title: Crispy Pork Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry with crispy pork and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry mix
ingredients.notes: pre-cut mix of bell peppers and carrots

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork strips and cook until browned and crispy, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the chopped green onions and minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the stir-fry mix and cook until tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the pork strips to the skillet and stir in the flaky salt and Mexican oregano.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce and the vegetables are tender.
